newsitem.title: USA: Technology Service sees renewed growth.
newsitem.headline: Technology Service sees renewed growth.

text.p: Technology Service Group Inc said on Friday it expects sales to increase in 1997 as its customers, including NYNEX Corp, boost their orders of payphone system products.

The company reported earnings per share of $0.01 for the third quarter, ending December 27, on sales of $5.7 million. That was down from $0.17 per share on sales of $9.6 million for the same quarter a year earlier.
For the first three quarters the company reported earnings per share of $0.21 on sales of $27.8 million, up from $0.17 per share on sales of $23.7 million for the nine-month period a year ago.

The company attributed the nine-month growth to strong demand for its products from NYNEX during the first six months under a previous agreement. With a new NYNEX deal in place, the company sees similar growth in the year to come.
